items.title: Anthropic to debut amid security worries and SpaceX to finance GPU rentals
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) expected IPO to launch amid multiple security worries, SpaceX (SPCX) financing GPU rentals, and getting around the AI bottleneck.

Deirdre Bosa then sits down with Micron (MU) president and CTO Scott J. DeBoer to discuss the chip stock sell-off, Washington putting the screws to China in the AI trade, and TSMC's (TSM) potential move into memory.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: DoorDash (DASH) Brings Ride Rewards And Food Credits Together In Lyft Go
items.summary: DoorDash (NasdaqGS:DASH) and Lyft have launched Lyft Go, a joint rewards and ordering program linking rides with food delivery credits. The partnership integrates DoorDash restaurant ordering directly inside the Lyft app for eligible users in supported US markets. Lyft Go members receive DoorDash order credits tied to qualifying ride activity, creating a bundled experience across both platforms.
